items.title: GE HealthCare’s (GEHC) Latest Scanner Breakthrough Meets A Mixed Market
items.summary: On August 31, GE HealthCare (NASDAQ:GEHC) announced that its Photonova Spectra photon-counting CT scanner had received CE Mark approval, opening the door to sales across Europe and other regions that recognize the certification. The clearance followed US FDA 510(k) clearance and Japanese regulatory approval in March 2026, meaning the machine cleared three major regulatory bodies […]
